# CMS Requirements Quality Checklist: Editor-managed site content

**Purpose**: Pre-plan reviewer gate. Are the requirements for content coverage, composition, newsroom
destinations, credential security, the build-time/host-agnostic constraint, design fidelity and failure
handling complete, clear, consistent and measurable?
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist` (standard depth, reviewer audience). Items test the WRITTEN
requirements, not an implementation. Evaluation results are in *Run log* below.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Does the spec list every page and shared region whose content must become editable? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 - Is every repeating list on the site named as editor-ordered and editor-sized? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 - Are the sections in the arrangeable-section library enumerated, and do they cover every block used on services, industries and about? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK004 - Is it specified which articles appear on the insights listing and newsroom, and in what order, as distinct from which articles get pages? [Gap → fixed, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK005 - Are requirements defined for editable copy that contains runtime values (the contact thank-you that names the sender and their email)? [Gap → fixed, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK006 - Are SEO fields and their site-wide fallbacks specified for every page type, including articles? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, US4]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 - Is the fixed-vs-arrangeable split stated per page with no page left unassigned (home, insights, contact, article = fixed; services, industries, about = arrangeable)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK008 - Is the "exactly one destination" rule for newsroom items unambiguous, including how external links open? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK009 - Is "stays in code" (FR-001 exceptions) listed explicitly rather than implied? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK010 - Are statistic values constrained to numbers, so the count-up interaction is always possible? [Gap → fixed, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK011 - Is headline emphasis defined as editor-controlled rather than tied to a word? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK012 - Is the editor-ordered insights list (FR-002) consistent with the home "latest insights" fallback-by-date rule? [Consistency → fixed, Spec §FR-018, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK013 - Do the newsletter requirements (copy editable, success/validation messages in code) agree between FR-001 and the entities? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Key Entities]
- [x] CHK014 - Is "no draft preview" consistent with "content fetched only at build time" and the out-of-scope publishing decision? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK015 - Is design fidelity stated as a measured threshold with an exact scope (pages × widths, states), not an adjective? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, FR-015]
- [x] CHK016 - Can "100% of visible content editable" be verified by a defined audit procedure? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK017 - Is the setup-time target (under 15 min) bounded by what it includes and excludes? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK018 - Are failure requirements defined for an unreachable content service, bad credentials, missing required fields and broken references? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-017]
- [x] CHK019 - Are duplicate/invalid article addresses and deleted-but-referenced articles addressed? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 - Is re-running the seed on a populated space addressed (idempotency)? [Recovery, Spec §US1-AS4, FR-011]
- [x] CHK021 - Are rollback/reversal requirements defined for content-structure changes? [Gap → fixed, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK022 - Is behavior specified for editor content much longer than the design copy? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Assumptions]

## Non-Functional (Security, Hosting)

- [x] CHK023 - Are read vs. management credentials separated, with management credentials limited to setup? [Security, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK024 - Is "no credential in the built site or history" measurable? [Security, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK025 - Does the host-agnostic constraint state what the built output must NOT need (server, runtime credentials)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK026 - Is alternative-text required for meaningful images, with decorative images allowed to omit it? [Accessibility, Spec §Edge Cases, US2-AS4]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK027 - Are the owner-provided dependencies (account, space, credentials, real images) stated as assumptions with who provides them? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK028 - Is the content service's request limit during builds acknowledged as an assumption? [Gap → fixed, Spec §Assumptions]

## Run log

- **Iteration 1 (2026-09-30):** 22/28 passed. 6 gaps were found and the spec was updated:
  - CHK004 / CHK012: added FR-018 (listing and newsroom membership and order are curated; every
    published article still gets a page).
  - CHK005: added FR-019 (runtime tokens in editable copy).
  - CHK010: statistics are numeric.
  - CHK021: FR-010 now requires every structure change to be additive or reversible, and an export
    before any destructive step.
  - CHK028: added a build-request-volume assumption.
- **Iteration 2:** 28/28 pass.
